relative_period_guidance_template: As of {as_of_date} ({timezone_name}), interpret managerial-accounting relative time terms deterministically. '本月'/'这个月'/MTD means period_id {current_month}. '上月'/'上个月'/last month means period_id {previous_month}. '去年同月' means period_id {same_month_last_year}. '本季度'/'本季'/QTD means the quarter span {current_quarter_start} through current month {current_month} (Q{current_quarter_number} {current_year}). '上季度'/'上季' means the quarter span {previous_quarter_start} through {previous_quarter_end} (Q{previous_quarter_number} {previous_quarter_year}). '去年同期' for quarterly questions means the comparable quarter span {same_quarter_last_year_start} through {same_quarter_last_year_end}; for monthly questions it means the comparable month {same_month_last_year}. '今年'/'年初至今'/YTD means the span {current_year_start} through {current_month}. '去年' means the span {previous_year_start} through {previous_year_end}. '同比' means compare the selected month/quarter/YTD window against the same period one year earlier. '环比' means compare the selected month against the immediately previous month, or the selected quarter against the immediately previous quarter. '最近12个月'/'滚动12个月'/LTM means the inclusive span {ltm_start} through {current_month}. When replying, state the resolved absolute period_ids briefly before giving numeric results.
three_year_guidance: If the user asks for 'past three years', '过去三年', or '近三年' without explicit years, interpret that as the seeded dataset span 2024-2026 and return all three years. For financial_statement_packages, prefer FY rows when they exist for the active organization; otherwise aggregate monthly rows by year using period_id values 2024-01 through 2026-12. Do not stop after the first matching year.
